content.text: Hey, Xiaomeng! Check out the screenshot of my latest game stats—I was on fire, racking up MVPs like it was nothing!

Wow, Star, these stats are amazing! I've been watching streams and guides, and practicing the techniques you taught me recently, and I feel like I've improved. Do you remember the mid-lane hero tier list you showed me last time? I've been studying it carefully.
Haha, I knew you’d give it your all! So, how about teaming up for a round? I’ll carry you! Last time I asked, you said you weren’t in the mood and needed a break. You must be ready now, right?

Great, I've been wanting to give it a try. Last time, you comforted me after my losing streak, and this time I don't want to hold anyone back. Plus, I haven't forgotten what you said last time about 'fun first'—I've adjusted my mindset this time!

Don't worry, it's just a game—having fun is what matters most! Pick a strong hero, and we'll definitely have a great time working together. Just go with the T0 or T1 heroes I recommended earlier, and you'll be all set.
Well, I've been practicing in the mid lane, and it feels pretty good. Shall we log in? This time, I really want to experience the 'joy of victory' you promised last time!
Let's go! I'm already waiting for you in the team room, hurry and join! This time, I promise to make you laugh out loud, just like I said last time!
Coming, coming! Hold on, I'm logging in right now.
I'll be waiting for you, don't keep me waiting too long, or I might just start performing a stand-up comedy routine!
Haha, you're still such a drama queen! I'm in the room now, I see you.
Perfect! Let's start matching. Remember, relax and enjoy the process! Don't let the matchmaking system affect your mood like last time.
Okay, with you here, I feel much more at ease. This time, I'm going to give it my all and not let down the expectations of a 'capable expert' like you.
Absolutely! I'll support you in the jungle and ensure the mid lane is wide open. Let me show you how to play those high-power heroes I showed you last time!
Thank you! After playing, I'll share my results with you too. Hopefully, they won't be too bad. At the very least, it won't be another screenshot of 'losing five games in a row' like last time.
Looking forward to your performance! The game has begun, stay focused!

Xingchen, look at my match record screenshot! I got the top mid-laner title for the first time, I'm so excited! Compared to the last record I showed you, which was full of 'defeats', this is like night and day!
Wow, Xiaomeng, you're amazing! You've made such rapid progress; it seems my teaching wasn't in vain! Remember when I said last time, 'I'll take you flying'? This time, we've truly taken off!

Thanks to your previous encouragement and recommendation. This gaming experience was really great; I felt like we cooperated very well. Thank you for not looking down on my poor skills back then and for always comforting me.

Exactly, a harmonious relationship plus fun games, the perfect combination! Let's plan another time to push for higher ranks together! Just like we agreed last time, 'Call me anytime, and we'll climb the ranks together'!
Sure, I'm ready anytime. I had a great time today, thank you, Xingchen! It feels like all the frustration from the previous losing streak has been completely swept away.
